blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives will soon launch a transparency platform on its website that will allow Filipinos to scrutinize government-funded projects, including their locations, funding allocations, and implementation status, Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III announced on Monday. The project is part of continuing reforms to strengthen transparency and accountability in public spending, he said. Dy also ordered all House oversight committees to immediately convene and review how government departments and agencies spent their 2026 budget allocations, emphasizing that congressional responsibility extends beyond approving public funds to ensuring that these are properly spent.
